candidates.transformation_method: scripts/fetch_round334_nyc_lpc_permit_next31_candidates.js queried official NYC Open Data dpm2-m9mq rows with issue_date from 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-20, required official latitude/longitude and regulation_number, scored architecture-facing WorkTypes/regulation_type values, deduplicated against the current corpus plus prior LPC permit/designation packs through round329, and selected up to 200 high-signal administrative milestones without inferring physical work.
